params.body:
A service gets an optional photo (`image`, a `siteImage` with hotspot, crop and alt text), so the workshop photos in the media library can go on the services page. The site shows it wide under the lead (ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet, same branch name).

The field sits right under Inleiding and says what kind of photo fits (landscape, at least 1600 px wide). `CONTRACT.md` and the contract test include it.

## Checked

- `npx sanity build`: succeeds.
- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- `npx vitest run`: 11 passed.

After merge the Studio needs a deploy (`npm run deploy`) before editors see the field.
params.title: Service: an optional photo
